scope_note: Selected original IFRS consolidated financial statement tables from Item 18: balance sheet (assets and liabilities/equity), profit or loss and other comprehensive income, changes in equity, and cash flows, with the U.S. dollar translation note and unit captions. Also selected relevant notes: cash and cash equivalents (Note 7), bonds payable (Note 18), long-term bank loans (Note 19), and capital stock (Note 21). These provide the requested FY2023 metrics (revenue, operating income, operating cash flow, cash purchases of PP&E, ending cash and cash equivalents) and retain the presented annual comparative periods 2021-2023 for flows and 2022-2023 for balances.
gaps: Management summary/percentage tables in Item 5 are excluded because they are rounded and not the complete original financial statements.
Parent-only and Obligor Group summarized financial statements are excluded because target metrics require consolidated figures.
The balance sheet presents comparative periods only for 2022 and 2023; no 2021 balance sheet is included.
U.S. dollar amounts are convenience translations only; primary reporting currency is New Taiwan dollars (millions).
